newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's bank liquidity up 3.14 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's bank liquidity up 3.14 pct in August.

text.p: Ecuador's Central Bank said Monday liquidity in the bank system grew 3.14 percent, or 46 million sucres, to 15.20 billion sucres in August.
In the first eight months, liquidity increased 21.47 percent.
At the end of July, bank liquidity stood at 14.74 billion sucres and in August 1995 at 10.88 billion sucres.
Total liquidity in the bank sector ended 1995 at 12.51 billion sucres, up 41.2 percent from 1994.
